title: Paper bag throw: air drag measured in 20x slow motion
description: A crumpled paper bag thrown across the frame, filmed at 200 fps. Of three drag laws, only drag proportional to speed forecasts the held-out flight (2.9% error; quadratic drag is 883 BIC worse): k = 2.43 ± 0.05 per second. No ruler is in view, so lengths are set by assuming Earth's gravity, and the result says so.
